description: This file defines the ICatalogViewModelService interface, which specifies methods for retrieving catalog items, brands, and types, likely used in the e-commerce web application's catalog feature.

classes.name: ICatalogViewModelService
classes.description: Interface for catalog view model services, providing methods to fetch catalog items, brands, and types.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of catalog items, optionally filtered by brand and type.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available brands for filtering.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available catalog types for filtering.
